newsitem.title: USA: Mueller says optimism due to strong housing.
newsitem.headline: Mueller says optimism due to strong housing.

text.p: Mueller Industries said earnings in the second quarter were helped by a strong housing market and it expects the rest of 1997 to be solid.

Mueller reported earnings per share of 83 cents in the second quarter compared to 71 cents during the same time a year ago. Net income rose 17-1/2 percent in the second quarter to $16.3 million compared to $13.9 million during the same period a year ago.

Commenting on the earnings report, Harvey Karp, chairman of Mueller said, "Capacity and yield are still rising at our manufacturing operations, with the prospect of further improvements. Although new housing starts softened slightly during the second quarter, the housing market remains strong, buoyed by fixed 30 year mortgage rates below eigtht percent. Consequently, we are optimistic that Mueller's business will continue to be sound for the balance of 1997."
Mueller makes copper tubing, fittings and other metallurgical building products.
